# Dragoon's Town 0.30 release notes

## Consistent business purchase feedback

- Buying from the selected business panel now shows the same opening, delivery or construction moment as buying directly on the town map.
- Purchases crossing 25, 100 or 1,000 locations continue to show one bounded scaffold-and-builder moment.
- Failed purchases do not display a success effect, and bulk or manager purchases do not queue animations.

## Comfort and compatibility

- Existing activity, reduced-motion, battery-saver, browser visibility and Android lifecycle controls still govern the effect.
- Existing saves, prices, income, prestige, milestones, artwork, Android package and original signing identity remain compatible.
- Real payments and ads remain disabled.

Browser and compatible Android publication will follow only after complete source, viewport, mobile-touch, package and signature checks pass. Physical Android 13/Thor testing remains separate and is not claimed by automated verification.
